niche_preference_profile: This user prefers polished, high-contrast interfaces with strong visual hierarchy, clear section separation, and prominently surfaced key content or actions. They often like dark backgrounds when paired with vivid contrast, organized card-like structure, and layouts that feel spacious and refined. They also favor visible information richness when it is well-structured, though in some contexts they prefer fewer competing controls and less clutter. Rounded controls, prominent primary buttons or focal elements, restrained but purposeful accent usage, and clear, legible controls are recurring preferences.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers interfaces with strong hierarchy, clearly separated sections, grouped content blocks, and obvious emphasis on the active or most important elements.
Prefers strong contrast between main content and surrounding UI, with accent or content areas standing out clearly rather than blending into the screen.
Prefers richer information and more visible detail when it is organized into labeled rows, cards, stats blocks, or segmented sections rather than left sparse or ambiguous.
Prefers airy, balanced layouts with refined spacing, alignment, and an overall polished finish rather than cramped or rough presentations.
Prefers key actions or focal content to be highly prominent, such as large full-width buttons, top-placed primary actions, centered icons, or clearly visible hero content like album art.
Prefers organized components with cards, dividers, segmented controls, separated rows, and other structural devices that make content easier to parse.
Prefers softer, more rounded UI elements and modern control styling over sharper, more compact treatments.
